name: Docker MCP Gateway
description: Runs containerized MCP servers from the Docker MCP Catalog behind one gateway, managed with the `docker mcp` CLI plugin or Docker Desktop's MCP Toolkit, with secrets and OAuth.

skills.name: Run MCP Gateway
skills.description: Starts a single MCP gateway with `docker mcp gateway run` that fronts many containerized servers over stdio or HTTP.

skills.name: Server Profiles
skills.description: Groups MCP servers into profiles with per-tool allowlists and config, then exports or shares them via OCI registries.

skills.name: Catalog Management
skills.description: Creates, pulls, and pushes OCI-based MCP catalogs, including the default Docker MCP Catalog and community registries.

skills.name: Client Connection
skills.description: Connects a profile to MCP clients such as Claude Code or Cursor with `docker mcp client connect` for shared tool config.
